chunks: When the zakat exceeds twenty dinars, then for every four dinars there is one-tenth of a dinar.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةُ: zakat — obligatory alms-tax, one of the pillars of Islamic worship
key_terms.دِينَار: dinar — gold coin used as the standard currency in classical Islamic fiscal law
key_terms.عُشْرُ دِينَارٍ: one-tenth of a dinar — the incremental zakat rate applied to gold beyond the nisab

ai.seo_question: What is the zakat rate on gold beyond twenty dinars according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith narrated from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes the incremental zakat rate for gold once it surpasses the nisab threshold of twenty dinars. The ruling specifies that beyond the initial twenty dinars, each additional four dinars incurs a liability of one-tenth of a dinar (i.e., 2.5%), maintaining consistent proportionality. This precision in zakat calculation reflects the Shia jurisprudential tradition of faithful transmission of Imamic rulings on fiscal worship obligations.
